{{Quote|They're right behind you!|The droid speaking with Nute Gunray|<ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>}}
A '[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|''B1-Series battle droid''']] served under command of a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid lieutenant/Legends|battle droid lieutenant]] at [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous's castle/Legends|Grievous's castle]] on the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon of Vassek]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
When viceroy Nute Gunray [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|escaped]] the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], this droid along with a squad of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] was assigned to protect a hologram of Gunray, which was intended to throw the pursuers off track. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] along with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] and a [[Fil's Squad/Legends|Fil's squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] reached the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|Third moon of Vassek]] and entered into a mysterious castle, they discovered what seemed to be the viceroy, guarded by a group of battle droids, including this one. Eventually, the droids noticed the task force while conversing with the viceroy and engaged them, only to be destroyed by the Jedi moments later.
